title: Ledger Flex from MediaMarkt, Berlin, shared by @Mikaelxp14

purchase.dateNote: Not given. The post links a Google Maps pin for MediaMarkt Tech Village Berlin (Grunerstraße 20) as the store where the device was bought.

implant.notes: The owner (@Mikaelxp14) says more than $320,000 was drained from their Ledger Flex on 14 November 2026, the same day as the Virgin Megastore Dubai Stax theft. They bought it at MediaMarkt Tech Village in Berlin, Germany. The post lists two BTC transactions and one USDT (TRC-20) transaction, with the hashes split across lines (one contains "ele3e", probably a typo for "e1e3e"). No photos of the inside of the device have been published, so the implant is suspected but not confirmed. The implanted Nano X devices bought by Johannes (@0xJohannes_) also came from MediaMarkt, at least one of them in Germany.

sources.author: OxC40day
